The '''red miont''' was a species of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cols/Legends|Cols]]. Their primary prey was smaller fish such as the [[kalaide]]s.<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
